THE VERB AND ITS EXIT CODES. In main(), 'show' with a target that is not 'artifact', 'usage' or one of the existing section names now runs: result = show_item(args[1]); print(result); return 0 if not (result.startswith('no pending artifact') or result.startswith('ambiguous')) else 1. USAGE gained the line: show <slug|id>          any item the inbox lists — idea, question, trouble, ticket, intention, adjudication, artifact — by the id or slug it printed; exits 1 when nothing (or more than one thing) matches.

HOW A TOKEN MATCHES — _match_grade(token, ident, title) returns _EXACT (0) when fold(ident) == token; _PREFIX (1) when the token is hex-ish (_HEXISH = ^(open-)?[0-9a-f]{4,}$) and ident.startswith(token) — so 'open-0123' names open-0123456789ab but 'loop' does NOT name loop-not-beating; _LOOSE (2) when ident.endswith('-' + token) (an idea's date-stripped tail: 'a-lot-of-things-look-alike' names 2026-01-01-a-lot-of-things-look-alike) or _slugify(token) equals _slugify(ident) or _slugify(title); None otherwise. resolve() keeps only the hits at the BEST (lowest) grade, so 'c691e19d5464' returns the ticket alone and not the trouble boat-crossed-to-proved-uncovered-c691e19d5464 whose slug merely ends in the id. A candidate listed in both an open lane and a reference lane is counted once, under the open lane (a seen-set on fold(ident)).
